input.relationship: src/lru.ts#imageAllocation call src/weights.ts#allocationWeight (forward); src/weights.ts#allocationWeight value-reference src/weights.ts#entryWeight (forward)

evidence.reason: New function divides weights.allocationWeight(bytes, 0.1, 'image') by weights.byteUnit, so it relies on allocationWeight returning a byte-scaled value consistent with entryWeight's prior byteUnit multiplication.

Refactored to return weightDetails(bytes, overhead, category).bytes, removing the explicit RangeError check and header/byteUnit arithmetic; the merged behavior now depends on weightDetails preserving those semantics.
Comment states the cache capacity includes index overhead in byte units; the refactor must keep weightDetails returning the same byte-scaled value for this comment to remain accurate.
Caller returns imageAllocation(bytes), so any unit or validation change in the allocationWeight/entryWeight path propagates to admittedBytes.
Caller interpolates imageAllocation(bytes) into a label, so a unit change would silently alter displayed values.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动通过 allocationWeight 与 entryWeight 的依赖链耦合，但缺少 allocationWeight 和 weightDetails 的实现，无法确认重构后单位与校验行为是否保持一致，因此建议谨慎处理。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/weights.ts 的 entryWeight 或 weightDetails 维护者确认 weightDetails(bytes, overhead, category).bytes 仍返回与原先相同的字节单位值，并保留对负 bytes 的 RangeError 校验；若无法确认，应调整 src/weights.ts#entryWeight 以显式保留原校验与单位换算。
